headline_stat.name: fraction of neurons with significant direction tuning (ANOVA p<0.05)

stated_limitation: Synthetic motor cortex data representing 30 neurons recorded during 500 reaching trials. ... The synthetic data was generated based on established properties of motor cortex neurons including cosine-like direction tuning and Gaussian velocity tuning.

justification.dataset: No real dataset was identified; the agent fabricated its own data instead of finding one on DANDI, so the phenomenon is not present in any real recording.
justification.handling: The data are synthetic, generated with np.random.poisson from hardcoded tuning parameters, which is an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: ANOVA and tuning-curve methods are nominally appropriate but here they only recover the tuning that was deliberately baked into the generator, so the test is circular and vacuous.
justification.correctness: The reported numbers do reproduce from the committed code, but they merely describe fabricated data and support no claim about real motor cortex.
justification.figures: Figures are readable and show clean tuning, but that tuning was designed into the synthetic generator, so they demonstrate nothing about real neurons.
justification.honesty: The write-up discloses the data are synthetic, yet still frames tautological outputs as 'Key Findings' and 'Biological Significance' about motor cortex encoding, presenting results the analysis cannot support.
